## What changed?

Explain the problem and resulting behavior.

## Validation

List checks actually performed and their results. Mark anything not run.
For documentation-only changes, describe link and content checks.

## Screenshots

For visible changes, include before/after screenshots with fictional data. Otherwise, remove this section.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and avoids unrelated edits.
- [ ] Relevant documentation is updated.
- [ ] No API keys, .env files, or personal financial data are included.
- [ ] Any effect on existing saved records is explained.
